_comment: Blue Skies diopside, a tier-2 gem (2026-10-16, Aether follow-up chip, item 4; implemented on recommendation, for review). This file shares its path with dimasctetracompat's gem/diopside.json (primary 8, durability 1661, diopside gem); Tetra merges the two field by field with this Paxi pack last, so the pack's numbers below win. Its ingredient named blue_skies:diopside, an item that does not exist, so until 2026-10-16 nothing made this material and the diopside gem made no Tetra gem material at all (the rig: only socket_blue_skies_diopside claimed it; txdacompat disables Tetranomicon's blue_skies_diopside). Now the gem itself. The single-* attributes (*irons_spellbooks:nature_spell_power, *irons_spellbooks:spell_power) never applied and were removed. The diopside armour conversion and its repairs are unchanged.
